about_us.title: About Us
about_us.content1: Attentive (əˈten(t)iv) is a psychology service bureau that was established in 2020. Attentive provides scientific-based, measurable, and reliable psychology services in helping clients.
about_us.content2: Attentive seeks to understand human thoughts, feelings, and behavior with the aim of providing appropriate and effective assistance according to the needs of each client. All forms of treatment from professional counseling and psychoeducation to research are our way of showing our concern for your mental health.

services.title: Adult Psychotherapy
services.content: Our experienced therapists provide a safe and supportive environment to address various mental health concerns, develop coping strategies, and foster personal growth.

services.title: Child & Adolescent Psychotherapy
services.content: Provide a safe and supportive space for young individuals to explore their emotions, develop coping strategies, address various mental health concerns, improve their mental well-being, and enhance their overall emotional health.

faq.title: It is okay to have questions.
faq.description: Starting psychological support can feel unfamiliar. Here are clear answers to the things people often ask first.

items.question: How do I know which psychologist is right for me?
items.answer: Begin with the concern you want to work through, then review each psychologist's experience and approach. If you are still unsure, our admin can help narrow the options through WhatsApp.

items.question: Can I talk to someone even if I am not sure what I need help with?
items.answer: Yes. You do not need a diagnosis or a perfectly defined problem before reaching out. Describing what has been difficult lately is enough to begin.

items.question: Are sessions available online and in person?
items.answer: Yes. Online consultations are available, and in-person sessions can be arranged at our Jakarta and BSD locations depending on psychologist availability.

items.question: Will my psychologist understand my cultural background and experience?
items.answer: You can review areas of experience in each profile and ask the admin about preferences that matter to you. A comfortable therapeutic relationship is an important part of the process.

items.question: Are sessions private and confidential?
items.answer: Sessions are conducted in a private setting and professional confidentiality applies within the boundaries of psychological practice and applicable safety obligations.

items.question: What happens during the first session?
items.answer: The first session usually focuses on understanding your concerns, goals, relevant background, and what kind of support may be useful. You can also decide whether the connection feels right.

closing.title: Start wherever you are.
closing.description: You do not need the right words, a diagnosis, or everything figured out. You just need somewhere to begin.
